text: No fire has been detected near the asset in the past month. The analysis checked for active fires or thermal anomalies from October 4 to November 3, 2026, using NASA’s FIRMS data (VIIRS and MODIS sensors). Despite full coverage by all sensors during this period, no detections intersected the asset’s location. The data is reliable, as every day was monitored without gaps. Therefore, the asset has not been affected by recent fires.
